title: Mardi Gras advertising bands on trucks
summary: Love recalls the competing advertising bands on trucks at Mardi Gras, with his out-of-town band last on the truck in 1914.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Buddy P.T., Sam Morgan, you know, they'd be bucking against one of them. One right behind them, one band on a big truck or something like that.
